#/caching/13.heading: Recap
#/caching/13.bodySample: Recap Cache answers that are read often and change rarely. Cache-aside: check the cache, fall back to the database, then fill the cache. Hit rate drives both speed and database load. Plan for staleness: invalidate on write, add a TTL, evict with LRU. Protect hot keys from stampedes: one fetch, early refresh, jittered TTLs.
